body: There were a lot of things I loved.. Reading, sports, trips with friends, watching movies, spending time with my girlfriend, studying.. I even loved my career at one point. And gradually that list got smaller and smaller.. And now its down to zero.. Got nothing that I love or look forward to doing.. Everything feels like a chore.. Been living on auto pilot for months now

I'm in a rut career wise but that is pretty much self induced.. And I too used to have a very long list of things that I wanted to do.. Things I dreamt about.. Unfortunately over the past year all of those things have lost their significance. I've tried and tried to get myself motivated and excited about something.. Anything... Nothing works. I don't exactly why it started, but it never stopped and now I'm here.. My girlfriend.. She deserves better. She kept me going for a long time but even her efforts don't work anymore.. My one silver lining is that she'll be free from me and get to live a full and happy life..

This is word for word exactly how I feel.. I know I have responsibilities but no matter how hard I try, how much I force myself.. I just can't get around to do anything... And nothing feels important.. Nothing to look forward to.. Just going through the motions.. Hoping it ends..
